intro: Rocks to Rests is a lighthearted errand for Thra, an orc youth playing games with friends behind Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar. The children need an adventurer's strength to haul smooth boulders into their clearing to use as makeshift chairs and tables. It offers a charming glimpse into the everyday life and games of the younger generation growing up within the Horde capital.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hey! You've got time to help us out! I know you do, I can tell by the way you smiled watching the game we're playing.
This spot behind Grommash Hold is nice because it's clear enough for us to set up our figures. But what stinks is we don't have enough rocks for chairs or tables.
You're big and strong... D'ya think you could carry back some medium-sized rocks, smooth enough to sit on if we need a rest?

clips.title: Progress
paras: It's nice to not have to always sit in the dirt!

clips.title: Completion
paras: How can you even hold all of those boulders!
Those are great. Most even have a nice flat side, too. Now that you carried them all the way over here we can scoot them around in the dirt, right where we want 'em.
